strings.cli.help.algorithm_desc:
Search algorithm: dp_merge (default), hamming; astar/dfs available via --algo-dir plugins
                           (use --list-algorithms to see all available,
                           including externally loaded plugins)
strings.cli.help.target_desc:
Target item with wanted enchantments
                           (e.g., diamond_sword[sharpness=3])
strings.cli.help.platform_desc: Platform: java, bedrock, or auto (default = Java)
strings.cli.help.solutions_desc: Maximum solutions (0 = unlimited, default: 1, max: {0}); AStar/DFS (plugins) only — DP/greedy strategies return a single best
strings.cli.help.format_desc: Output format: text (default), compact, or json
strings.cli.help.import_desc:
Import data file(s) into the active profile (JSON / CSV / MC official).
                           Comma-separated list supported.
strings.cli.help.edit_desc:
Edit the active profile's data before running
                           Format: <target>:<action>,<id>[,<field>=<val>...]
                           Targets: ench | eq | cat  Actions: add | mod | rm
                           e.g., --edit "ench:mod,sharpness,max_level=10"
strings.cli.help.export_desc: Export the active profile's data to file (.json / .csv) or stdout (--export -)
strings.cli.help.profile_desc: Active profile to solve with (auto-resolves dependencies)
strings.cli.help.publish_desc: Publish a profile as self-contained file: --publish <key>
strings.cli.help.config_desc:
Config key=value pairs (comma-separated).
                           Keys: ignore-penalty-cost, ignore-repair-cost
                           (all: true|false)
strings.cli.help.memory_desc: Memory budget for AStar (plugin) search in MB (default: auto); ignored by other strategies
strings.cli.help.max_time_desc: Max search time in seconds (0 = unlimited, default: 180; applies to all strategies)
strings.cli.help.max_threads_desc: Max thread pool size for parallel strategies (bb_dp, dp_merge); 0 = auto. No-op for single-threaded hamming (and astar/dfs when loaded as plugins)
strings.cli.help.algo_opt_desc: Algorithm-specific options as key=value pairs (comma-separated); keys are strategy-owned (e.g. bb_dp.chunk_bits)
strings.cli.help.verbose_desc: Show algorithm diagnostic counters on completion
strings.cli.err.duplicate_option: Duplicate option '--{0}', later value overrides earlier
strings.cli.err.invalid_config_pair: Invalid config pair: '{0}'. Expected key=value format.
strings.cli.err.unknown_config_key: Unknown config key: '{0}'. Valid keys: ignore-penalty-cost, ignore-repair-cost.
strings.cli.err.invalid_config_value: Invalid config value for '{0}': '{1}'. Expected 'true' or 'false'.
strings.cli.err.invalid_algo_opt: Invalid algo-opt pair: '{0}'. Expected key=value format.
strings.cli.err.invalid_memory: Invalid --memory value: '{0}'. Expected a positive integer or 'auto'.
strings.cli.err.invalid_max_time: Invalid --max-time value: '{0}'. Expected a non-negative integer.
strings.cli.err.solutions_not_positive: Number of solutions must not be negative (0 = unlimited)
strings.cli.err.unreachable_target: Target unreachable: the requested enchantments cannot be applied to the selected item (e.g. due to conflicts or missing prerequisites)
strings.cli.err.double_comma: Empty enchantment spec in list (double comma near position {0})
strings.cli.err.unknown_property: Unknown property key '{0}' in target item
strings.cli.err.inventory_rejects_source: In inventory mode, specify desired enchantments via --target brackets (e.g. --target "diamond_sword[sharpness=5]"); --source is not supported
strings.cli.err.invalid_numeric: Invalid numeric value for '{0}': '{1}' in operation: {2}
strings.cli.err.parse_failed: Failed to parse command line arguments
strings.output.verbose.too_expensive: ⚠ Peak cost exceeds 39 levels — may be "Too Expensive!" on anvil
strings.pipeline.err.target_no_enchants_with_sou: Target item has no enchantment requirements, but source enchantments were provided. Remove --source or specify target enchantments (e.g. --target "diamond_sword[sharpness=5]").
strings.main.err.target_no_enchants: Target item must specify at least one enchantment (e.g. --target "diamond_sword[sharpness=5]")
strings.main.err.ench_not_applicable: Enchantment '{0}' cannot be applied to '{1}' (not supported by this equipment)
strings.output.verbose.already_met: Goal already met — no forge steps needed.
